mission.title: Defender of the Filth
mission.description: Find out what Niobe's Zion operatives have planned against the Merovingian's associate.

phase.briefing:
Niobe recently paid the Merovingian an unannounced visit during a rather intimate moment with Persephone. It seems Niobe is spearheading a futile attempt to eliminate a certain associate of our employer. To ensure the safety of our associate, I need you to find out exactly what Niobe has planned.
Go to this address and bring back any intel these Neo-worshipping redpills hold in their slimy little hands. Your objective has been given to you -- I really don't care how you complete it.

enter.say: I'm seeing RSI signals of several Zion operatives, but I can't get a fix on the exact number. Watch yourself, {player}.
I'm sure you have it figured out by now -- the whole Morpheus thing. I'll fill you in at the end of your assignment. We don't leave our operatives in the dark... forever.

objective.text: Get the Zion access code from the Zion Ravager

done.say: You just picked up a Zion access code. I bet you a box of Tastee Wheat it's for the laptop in the other room.
There's a laptop in the next room. If you can get through its security system, search it!
We need to find that mission plan. Let me do a trace on it. If it's close, I can find out where -- hey, I got a lock! It's with someone named Pigeon. He's behind a locked door, which just opened.

objective.text: Get the Secret Plan from Pigeon

done.say: Flood needs that. Hit a hardline and upload the secret plan. I'll make sure he gets it.

objective.text: Upload the Secret Plan at a hardline

done.say: You'd think they wouldn't label important documents with the words: Secret Plan! No wonder you aren't working for Zion anymore.

near.say: You'll die for the death of Morpheus, traitor!
The operator said I requested another print out of the mission intel. Did someone -- hey! You're not part of our crew!

phase.briefing: The Zion operatives are in the middle of their mission. Instead of wasting time listening to me prattle on, get over there and recover the formula they want so badly.

enter.say:
Aksnes is in the back of this place. Unless I'm reading this code incorrectly, he has the formula.
You know what to do, {player}.

done.say: You have the formula! I'll send word to Flood.

near.say: Just close your eyes and think of the Oracle.

phase.briefing:
Most intriguing. The formula has a short list of chemical ingredients. We'll need it delivered to one of our technicians so we can determine what the chemicals are for. If it's a plan to take down our associate, your further assistance will be required.
Take the formula to Adam Giddings at this address... Well, what are you waiting for? Go!

enter.say: Adam Giddings is inside. Maybe he will shed some light on this formula and Assassin business.

objective.text: Give the formula to Adam Giddings

talk.say: Come in! Come in! Don't be shy... Flood told me to expect you. Said you had a bit of parchment to share with your friend Adam Giddings, don't you? Yes, yes. Come on. Give Adam Giddings the formula.

done.say: {player}! I hate to break up your little chat, but I'm seeing an unknown signal pop up on the vid, possibly a group. It could be Zion operatives looking for their formula.

Oh, what's this...? Is that what Zion is up to? Sly, dirty, rotten... ah, yes -- I forget my place...
Hm... I've seen this before. It's a formula for insecticide, a highly dangerous one at that. Two different types, no less. I know Zion wants to kill the Assassin, but it can't be possible with mere insecticide, unless... Oh no! Adam Giddings knows it now -- their plan might actually work! Those rotten, little, dirty... bastards!
Flood will be interested to hear this... Alright, be on your way. Adam Giddings needs to go over this formula... Lots of tests to run! Yes, yes...
Nicely done. That should dissuade Zion from sending more operatives -- for the time being, at least!

Things don't look good right now: the Merovingian hired the Assassin to kill Morpheus and you're under attack by Zion operatives because of it! This might get even more complicated... I wonder what Flood has to say about all of this.

mission.finish: I want to clear a few things up for you: We killed Morpheus. We couldn't share the truth with you until the appropriate time. If we had openly admitted responsibility for the death of Morpheus just days after it happened, tensions would have risen well above acceptable limits. This was for your protection, {player}; you know that.
